paper.title: RoboExam: A Shared-Task Benchmark for Robotic Components and Systems

tasks.requirement: Reproduce a demonstrated object order
Bind object categories to bins
Align, pour, and return the container upright
Place digits to form the largest number
Select and place the missing answer
Pack role-bound objects in a specified order
Align handles and hang all mugs
Cover and uncover objects in the required order
Count presses and confirm each stage
Match and insert shapes in the required order
Fit all tools into their matching slots
Execute dependent folds on a deformable object
Complete a stable multi-bowl stack
Identify and intercept a matching moving object
Align a pushed object with its target pose
Grasp, align, insert, and turn a key
Place multiple parts with support dependencies
Infer the target from a relation among objects
Reach target colors from visible current states
Place an object at a reference-defined midpoint
Reflect object positions and orientation across an axis
Clear and stabilize an obstacle before closing
Maintain a lifted pose while retaining free fluid
Maintain contact, then release after a visual cue
